import { MeshStandardNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';
import { uv, mix, smoothstep, uniform } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, PlaneGeometry, Mesh, PointLight, Color } = ctx.THREE;

  // 1. Root Container
  const group = new Group();

  // Pick colors from visual spec with fallbacks
  const colors = config.intent?.visualSpec?.colors ?? {
    ink: '#16161d',
    paper: '#e8ecf2',
    accent: '#ff2a38',
    surface: '#0b0b10'
  };

  // Tracking for resource cleanup
  const disposables = [];
  const activePrimitives = [];
  let loadedTexture = null;

  // 2. Local Studio Lighting for Machined-Metal Detail
  const rimLight = new PointLight(colors.accent, 1.4, 6);
  rimLight.position.set(1.5, 1.0, 0.5);
  group.add(rimLight);

  // 3. Card Base Plate (Engineered surface layout with TSL pattern)
  const plateGeo = new PlaneGeometry(2.4, 1.5);
  disposables.push(plateGeo);

  const uColorSurface = uniform(new Color(colors.surface));
  const uColorInk = uniform(new Color(colors.ink));
  const uColorAccent = uniform(new Color(colors.accent));

  const plateMaterial = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial();
  
  // Custom TSL Shader: Technical Diagonal Linear Gradient + Fine Accent Border Frame
  const coords = uv();
  const diagonalGrad = smoothstep(0.0, 1.2, coords.x.add(coords.y).div(2.0));
  const baseGradColor = mix(uColorSurface, uColorInk, diagonalGrad);
  
  // Sharp structural borders
  const horizBorder = smoothstep(0.0, 0.015, coords.x).mul(smoothstep(1.0, 0.985, coords.x));
  const vertBorder = smoothstep(0.0, 0.025, coords.y).mul(smoothstep(1.0, 0.975, coords.y));
  const borderMask = horizBorder.mul(vertBorder);
  
  plateMaterial.colorNode = mix(uColorAccent, baseGradColor, borderMask);
  plateMaterial.roughness = 0.52;
  plateMaterial.metalness = 0.55;
  disposables.push(plateMaterial);

  const plateMesh = new Mesh(plateGeo, plateMaterial);
  plateMesh.position.set(0, 0, -0.01);
  group.add(plateMesh);

  // 4. Decorative Image Node (/prism-mock/home/nodes/orb-decor.png)
  if (config.imageUrl) {
    const decorGeo = new PlaneGeometry(1.0, 1.0);
    disposables.push(decorGeo);

    const decorMat = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial({
      transparent: true,
      roughness: 0.2,
      metalness: 0.1
    });
    disposables.push(decorMat);

    const decorMesh = new Mesh(decorGeo, decorMat);
    decorMesh.position.set(0.6, 0.1, 0.01);
    group.add(decorMesh);

    ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(config.imageUrl)
      .then((texture) => {
        decorMat.map = texture;
        decorMat.needsUpdate = true;
        loadedTexture = texture;
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        console.warn('Failed to load pricing label image:', err);
      });
  }

  // 5. Build and Bind Typography ("Pricing 1")
  const textItems = config.textContent ?? config.intent?.visualSpec?.textContent ?? [];
  const mainText = textItems.find(item => item.role === 'headline' || item.text)?.text ?? 'Pricing 1';

  const textNode = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(mainText, {
    fontSize: 39,
    color: colors.paper,
    align: 'left'
  });
  
  // Position label within card margins
  textNode.position.set(-1.0, -0.1, 0.02);
  group.add(textNode);

  // 6. Atelier Technical Accents (Atelier micro-ruler lines)
  const rulerLineGeo = new PlaneGeometry(0.12, 0.01);
  const rulerLineMat = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial({ color: colors.accent, roughness: 0.5 });
  disposables.push(rulerLineGeo, rulerLineMat);
  
  const techTick = new Mesh(rulerLineGeo, rulerLineMat);
  techTick.position.set(-1.0, 0.25, 0.02);
  group.add(techTick);

  // 7. Motion Orchestration (GSAP weighted-settle transition)
  const tl = gsap.timeline();
  // Set initial state offset
  group.position.y += 0.15;
  group.scale.set(0.95, 0.95, 0.95);
  
  tl.to(group.position, {
    y: '-=0.15',
    duration: 0.8,
    ease: 'power3.out'
  });
  tl.to(group.scale, {
    x: 1, y: 1, z: 1,
    duration: 0.9,
    ease: 'power4.out'
  }, '<');

  // 8. Bind Cinematic Primitives if available in config
  const primList = config.cinematicPrimitives ?? [];
  primList.forEach((prim) => {
    if (ctx.primitives && typeof ctx.primitives[prim.name] === 'function') {
      const pInstance = ctx.primitives[prim.name](group, prim.params);
      if (pInstance) {
        activePrimitives.push(pInstance);
      }
    }
  });

  // 9. Standardized Cleanup and Handlers
  const cleanup = () => {
    // Kill Gsap timeline
    if (tl) tl.kill();

    // Kill active cinematic primitives
    activePrimitives.forEach((p) => {
      if (p && typeof p.cleanup === 'function') {
        p.cleanup();
      }
    });

    // Dispose texture loader resource
    if (loadedTexture && typeof loadedTexture.dispose === 'function') {
      loadedTexture.dispose();
    }

    // Dispose local Geometries / Materials
    disposables.forEach((resource) => {
      if (resource && typeof resource.dispose === 'function') {
        resource.dispose();
      }
    });
  };

  group.userData = {
    handlers: {},
    cleanup: cleanup
  };

  return group;
}
